skill.name: emailagentskill
skill.description: Plan, review, and coordinate agent-assisted email workflows with clear tool handoffs, QA checkpoints, approval gates, and production safety boundaries.
skill.summary: Design safer agent workflows for email planning, review, implementation, and operational handoffs.
skill.author: Sequenzy

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found safety-oriented instructions for agent handoffs, approval gates, audit trails, and live email system boundaries. No semantic security findings were identified.

content.value_statement: Email work often spans agents, tools, approvals, and live systems, which raises execution risk. This skill structures handoffs, QA checks, and approval gates before action.
actual_capabilities: Classifies agent roles for research, strategy, copy, implementation, QA, analysis, and operations.
Defines what agents may read, draft, change, or execute in email workflows.
Creates tool handoff plans with inputs, outputs, acceptance criteria, and risk levels.
Adds checkpoints for segmentation, legal claims, production edits, and performance interpretation.
Produces audit-friendly status reports and next actions for another agent.
limitations: Does not send email, import contacts, or change live production systems.
Does not replace legal, privacy, deliverability, or brand review.
Requires source materials and system context for precise recommendations.
Provider-specific steps remain operational guidance, not direct platform automation.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Campaign Handoff
use_cases.description: Map roles, inputs, outputs, QA checks, and approvals before agents draft or prepare campaign assets.

use_cases.title: Review an Email Automation Change
use_cases.description: Separate recommendation, implementation, QA, and approval steps for a risky automation update.

use_cases.title: Audit Multi-Agent Email Work
use_cases.description: Create an audit trail of assumptions, evidence, decisions, unresolved risks, and human owners.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Email Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when one agent needs a safe plan before drafting or reviewing email work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan my email task. Define the agent role, source materials, allowed actions, approval needs, QA checks, and next step.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Tool Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when one agent must pass email work to another agent or tool.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a tool handoff spec for this email workflow. Include inputs, expected outputs, acceptance criteria, risk level, owner, and approval gate.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Production Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before changing templates, automations, imports, DNS, suppression rules, or live sends.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed email production change. Separate recommendation from execution, list evidence, identify risks, require approvals, and define rollback steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Agent Operating Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for complex workflows that involve strategy, copy, implementation, QA, and operations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-agent operating model for this email program. Assign roles, handoffs, checkpoints, evidence requirements, approval gates, status reporting, and recovery paths.

output_examples.input: Plan an agent workflow for updating a welcome email sequence.
output_examples.output: The response assigns strategy, copy, implementation, QA, and operator roles. It lists required source materials, approval owners, risk gates, and rollback steps.

output_examples.input: Audit a proposed contact import prepared by another agent.
output_examples.output: The response separates review from execution. It checks consent, suppression status, field mapping, import owner, test plan, and explicit approval before upload.

output_examples.input: Prepare a handoff for another agent to continue deliverability work.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes evidence, unresolved risks, completed decisions, next actions, acceptance criteria, and the human owner for high-risk changes.

best_practices: Name the human owner before any high-risk email action.
Record assumptions, source materials, decisions, and rejected options.
Define rollback steps before production edits or live sends.
anti_patterns: Asking an agent to send, import, or change production settings without explicit approval.
Passing vague email tasks between agents without inputs, outputs, or acceptance criteria.
Treating performance analysis or legal claims as final without review.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It plans and reviews workflows. It requires explicit approval before any live email action.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is designed for Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and similar AI agent environments.

faq.question: What email tasks fit this skill?
faq.answer: It fits campaign planning, automation changes, imports, QA reviews, handoffs, and multi-agent coordination.

faq.question: Can it replace compliance review?
faq.answer: No. It helps identify review gates, but legal, privacy, and consent review remain human responsibilities.

faq.question: How does it reduce execution risk?
faq.answer: It separates planning from action, documents evidence, names owners, and requires approval for risky changes.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the email goal, source materials, platform context, available tools, permission boundaries, and approvers.
